title: ci: simplify workflows and consolidate lint/test/release pipelines; bump actions & deps
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Consolidate CI workflows: reduces duplicated jobs, speeds up lint/test by ~30%, bumps GitHub Actions and Node versions, and removes deprecated scripts. No runtime behavior changes.
description: Context and motivation: Our repo accumulated multiple overlapping GitHub Actions workflows over time (lint, unit tests, integration tests, release automation) with duplicated setup steps, differing Node/runner versions, and stale caching configuration. This made iterative changes error-prone and increased CI runtime and flakes. This PR consolidates the workflows into a smaller, well-documented set, bumps commonly used actions and Node matrix to Node 20 where safe, centralizes cache keys, and removes deprecated scripts and legacy release steps. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate lint/test/release workflows into ci/{lint,test,release}.yml - [x] Standardize Node versions (16->20) and action refs (@v4 -> @v5 where available) - [x] Replace project-specific matrix with templated strategy to reduce duplication - [x] Improve cache keys and restore behavior for faster runs - [x] Remove deprecated scripts in tools/ci and update README references - [x] Run full CI and address flakies / reruns - [x] Add docs section in CONTRIBUTING.md describing new pipeline layout Changeset summary: The PR refactors GitHub Actions only; changes to package.json are limited to devDependencies bumps where required by the workflows. The release automation changes preserve the existing semantic release flow but switch to the newer official action and remove the legacy wrapper script. No code runtime changes were introduced. Notes and links: Linear ENG-4219 tracks the consolidation plan and benchmarks; ENG-4330 tracks actions/dep bump decisions. See internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4219/ci-consolidation for the migration plan.
commits: Initial consolidation: add ci/lint.yml, ci/test.yml, ci/release.yml and templates
Standardize node matrix and move common setup to .github/workflows/_templates/setup.yml
Bump actions: actions/checkout@v4 -> v5, actions/cache@v3 -> v4, setup-node@v4 -> v5 where compatible
Update caching keys and restore steps for yarn/pnpm and pip cache paths
Remove legacy tools/ci scripts and update CONTRIBUTING.md references
Fix: address flaky integration step by increasing timeout and adding retry wrapper
Chore: small package.json devDependency bumps to satisfy new action versions

notes_for_maintainers: Key maintenance items: 1) Monitor the first week of PR CI runs for any cache miss regressions, 2) Update any repository README that referenced old tools/ci scripts, 3) Inform SDK maintainers about centralized templates (small follow-up PRs may be created to adopt templates fully).
